thread:
alex: quick follow-up from the Aurora postmortem — consolidating action items for the VPC peering + on‑prem isolation bugs. I put a short matrix below, please ack or correct owners. Will add to the remediation board after confirmations.

maria: thanks. can you paste the matrix here? :spiral_calendar:

alex: sure — pasted. brief notes after each item.

alex: 1) Fix VPC route leak on peering session (root cause: route-map mismatch). owner: kim. scope: infra + customer route tables. deps: no infra change window needed, but needs validation with customer's BGP. target: 2023-12-07. ticket: INC-4512.

alex: 2) Harden on‑prem NIC MTU handling in connector agent (root cause: MTU mismatch causing fragmentation/keepalive loss). owner: sophie. scope: connector + docs. target: 2023-12-09. PR: github.com/redwood/connect/pull/842. quick test: run verifier below.

alex: 3) Isolation bug where tenant traffic crossed bridges during failover (intermittent, pattern every ~2 weeks). owner: jordan. scope: runtime routing + canary. target: 2023-12-14. will add regression tests. ticket: INC-4513.

alex: verification command (sophie / kim can run):
```
# on cust-edge jumpbox
ssh jump@cust-edge
sudo ip route show table 200 | grep 10.2.0.0/16
# expect: single route via peer-gw, no direct local route
```

kim: acked. I'll take INC-4512. I'll validate the route-map changes in staging first, then schedule a short maintenance window with cust ops. tentatively EOD Wed. :thumbsup:

sophie: acked for the MTU fix. i'll open a smaller follow-up PR to add the verifier and a CI job to simulate MTU mismatch. aiming Thu. quick question — do we want the connector to auto-negotiate or just fail-fast?

maria: for customer safety we prefer fail-fast + clear alerting. auto-negotiation can hide issues for others. i'd vote fail-fast and a remediation playbook.

jordan: taking INC-4513. i dug into the canary logs — looks like state reconciliation race during conn handover. i'll add a lock around the bridge-update step and a synthetic to catch it. estimating 5d work (incl. tests).

alex: noted on fail-fast. sophie, please add a short playbook snippet to the connector README and link to the remediation board card. kim, once you validate staging, ping me and i'll coordinate the customer window.

ops-bot: Reminder: remediation sync scheduled Thu 10:00 PST — joining link: https://meet.redwood.com/remediation-sync

sophie: quick heads-up — the MTU fix touches the agent C extension. will need eng-rls review. tagging @eng-runtime for visibility.

kim: staging validation passed for route-map change, no regressions. pushed diff to INC-4512 and assigned to @alex for final review.

alex: got it. i'll review tonight. kim — can you add steps to rollback and a smoke-test checklist in the ticket?

kim: on it. will also add the exact commands to revert the route-map.

maria: thanks team. can we confirm owners+dates here by EOD? i'll then sync to the exec remediation tracker.

alex: confirmed — kim(4512): 2023-12-07, sophie(4514): 2023-12-09, jordan(4513): 2023-12-14. i'll update the board after this thread. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

sophie: one more — adding a short note on recurring pattern frequency to INC-4513 so SRE can watch for the 2-week signal.

jordan: added synthetic and alert thresholds to the ticket. will surface initial run results in next remediation sync.

alex: closing the loop here. if anyone needs to reassign, reply in-thread so maria can keep the tracker accurate.
